Coffee has a rich history that spans centuries and continents. In Yemen, the birthplace of coffee, the story begins in the 15th century and continues to shape the country's culture and economy today.

## Early History

The earliest known reference to coffee in Yemen dates back to the 15th century. Legend has it that a goat herder named Kaldi discovered the energizing effects of coffee berries when he noticed his goats becoming more active after eating them. ## Trade and Commerce

Coffee quickly became a valuable commodity in Yemen, and the country's port cities became major centers of trade. Coffee was exported to Europe and other parts of the world, and Yemeni merchants played a key role in establishing the global coffee trade.

561 = 713 - a

Entón, a6 = a = 713 - 561 = 152.
